text: Fire is characterized by a hot touch. It is of various kinds: eternal and non-eternal. The eternal is atomic in form, and the non-eternal is in the form of an effect. Furthermore, it is of three kinds based on the distinction between body, sense organ, and object. The body is well-known in the solar world. The sense organ is the eye, which perceives form and consists of the black pupil and the white part. The object is of four kinds, based on the distinction between earthly, celestial, digestive, and ore-derived. Earthly fire is such as common fire; celestial fire is such as lightning; digestive fire is the cause of the transformation of consumed food; and ore-derived fire is such as that in gold.
